en.t: After finishing his recitation, he leaned against a pillar.

units.source_text: 青年侍女们窥看他的姿态，都在心中赞美。

en.t: The young ladies-in-waiting stole glances at his figure and admired him in their hearts.

units.source_text: 天色已暮，随从人走到附近替薰君管理庄院的人们那里，取些草料来秣马。

en.t: As dusk had already fallen, the attendants went to the nearby people who managed Kaoru's estate and got some fodder to feed the horses.

units.source_text: 薰君全不知道，忽见许多村夫牧子跟着随从人来拜见主子了。

en.t: Kaoru knew nothing of this, and suddenly saw many villagers and herdboys following the attendants in to pay respects to their lord.

units.source_text: 他想：“被他们知道了实在不好啊！”

en.t: He thought, "It would be truly awkward if they found out."

units.source_text: 便托辞掩饰，说是为访问老侍女弁君而来的。

en.t: So he made an excuse to cover for himself, saying that he had come to visit the elderly lady-in-waiting Ben no Kimi.

units.source_text: 又吩咐弁君，叫她好好服侍两女公子，然后动身回京。

en.t: He also instructed Ben no Kimi to serve the two young ladies well, and then set out back to the capital.
